# Elevate Stats

> Elevate Stats is a hockey stats tracking app for amateur coaches. Capture,
> share, and learn from every shift, right from the bench, even when the rink
> has no signal. Elevate Stats is made by Elevate Sports Labs Inc., a Canadian
> company.

Pricing: the Free tier includes unlimited team-level game tracking, forever.
PRO is $14 CAD per month or $109 CAD per year and adds player and goalie
stats, AI coaching insights, opponent analysis and shot maps, full season
analytics, CSV import and export, and full game history. Every new account
gets 3 full games of PRO features free, with no credit card required. Custom
plans are available for clubs, associations, and leagues.

The app runs at https://app.elevatestats.app (a progressive web app, no
app store install required).

## Main pages

- [Features](https://elevatestats.app/features): live game tracking, analytics, sharing, and offline capability, explained in full
- [Pricing](https://elevatestats.app/pricing): Free vs PRO comparison, billing FAQ
- [About](https://elevatestats.app/about): the company and founder
- [Support](https://elevatestats.app/support): all help articles
